reviews.comment: Zhale did a good job blending theory and practice. The lectures were more math-heavy, but then the homeworks and labs focused on building and applying various ML models. She was very caring and always willing to answer questions (and the TA in my section was great as well). There was a textbook for the class but I didn't use it. Exams were hard.

She made this class really manageable and interesting. She cares a lot about her students and puts in a lot of effort to make the course content easily digestible, accessible, and useful. All of her notes and lectures are uploaded on Zoom, grading criteria are clear, and a majority of the grade is homework assignments. I would strongly recommend!
